findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false. Long-lived static key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and violates common key-management baselines for audit log encryption keys.

No policy argument is defined, so AWS applies the default KMS key policy granting the entire AWS account root full kms:* access, which allows any IAM principal in the account with sufficient IAM permissions to use or administer this audit-log encryption key. An explicit least-privilege key policy should restrict decrypt/administration to specific principals.
